{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm (though there are none, per earlier)
# But check for missing values in flipper_length_mm
print("Missing values in flipper_length_mm:", df['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum())

# Compute mean flipper length by species and island
df_mean_by_species_island = df.groupby(['island', 'species'])['flipper_length_mm'].mean().round(2)

df_mean_by_species_island"}
